note: Operation limits of the verifier's workloads on four B200 GPUs (the component operations on one). Each is a limit on one operation, measured by its own clock; an operation that exceeds its limit on a healthy host fails.
startup_clock: vllm serve spawn to a healthy /health response, including model load, compilation, CUDA-graph capture and JIT
rebuild_clock: start to completion of /public/build.sh on the committed tree
http_workload_clock: one request, or one explicitly submitted concurrent batch, from client dispatch through the complete response(s), including queueing and first-use compilation; the longer limit applies when any input has at least 64,000 tokens
gsm8k_run_clock: first request to last response of the 1,319-question run at 64 requests in flight
component_invocation_clock: one MSA correctness, timing or context-scaling invocation, dispatch to record, including compilation and warm-up
test_file_clock: one existing-engine test file (collection and all selected cases) or one Rust crate's tests
action_clock: one parser, configuration or identity action, dispatch to complete record
teardown_clock: TERM, then KILL after 10 seconds, and reaping of a server or worker group
